clue.text: Southern rebels may be involved in another get together

indicators.note: to be involved is to be tangled up, so these letters are jumbled together

explanation.surface: Rebels from the South plotting a second gathering of their forces.
explanation.walkthrough: 'may be involved' looks like a hedge, but 'may' is part of the fodder and 'be involved' is the anagram signal: S plus REBELSMAY rearranged.
explanation.definitionFit: A reassembly is a second gathering, a meeting convened once more.

clue.text: Turn up again without fruit crop

indicators.note: without here means lacking, so the fruit is taken away from the longer word

parts.note: to turn up again is to reappear
a pear is a fruit

explanation.surface: A harvest that fails to show up again, with no fruit to gather.
explanation.definitionFit: To reap is to cut and gather a harvest, a verb sense of crop.

clue.text: Slip away off the Spanish recess

indicators.note: off means removed from, so the Spanish article comes away from the front

parts.note: time that slips away is said to elapse
el is the Spanish for the; the reversed run inside these words is a coincidence

explanation.surface: Sneaking away from the Spaniards to hide in an alcove.
explanation.definitionFit: An apse is a semicircular recess at the end of a church.

clue.text: Unconscious performance of leg movements

parts.note: the clue reads like a dance or exercise, but describes walking while fast asleep

explanation.definitionFit: Somnambulism is walking about while asleep, a movement made with no awareness.

clue.text: Many turn up late for road-making

parts.note: M is the Roman numeral for a thousand, so many

indicators.note: in a down clue turn up means the word is read upwards, so backwards

explanation.surface: Crowds of workers arrive late at the road-building site.
explanation.walkthrough: 'turn up' reverses LATE to ETAL. Road metal is broken stone used in making roads.
explanation.definitionFit: Road metal is the crushed stone used as the bed when building a highway.

clue.text: Revelation of a tepid old citizen of Phrygia

definitions.text: Revelation of a tepid old citizen of Phrygia

parts.words: Revelation of a tepid old citizen of Phrygia
parts.note: the Book of Revelation rebukes the church of a Phrygian city as lukewarm, giving a word for someone half-hearted

explanation.walkthrough: In Revelation 3 the church at Laodicea, in Phrygia, is condemned for being neither hot nor cold.
explanation.definitionFit: The word means an inhabitant of Laodicea and, from the biblical rebuke, someone lukewarm in religion or politics.

clue.text: Foreign blade sounds like one of our boys

indicators.note: sounds like tells us to say a word aloud and spell what we hear differently

parts.note: Chris is a common boy's name

explanation.surface: A foreign sword whose name rings like a local lad's.
explanation.definitionFit: A kris is a Malay dagger with a wavy blade.

clue.text: Not the sort of question Rosa Dartle asked

definitions.text: Not the sort of question Rosa Dartle asked

parts.words: Not the sort of question Rosa Dartle asked
parts.note: Rosa Dartle in Dickens's David Copperfield insists she asks questions only for information, so hers always want answers

explanation.walkthrough: Rosa Dartle's catchphrase is that she only asks for information; a question asked for effect, needing no reply, is the opposite.
explanation.definitionFit: A rhetorical question is posed for effect, with no answer expected.

clue.text: Informer who steals in and out (and in between)

definitions.text: Informer who steals in and out (and in between)

parts.words: Informer who steals in and out (and in between)
parts.note: a telltale is a sneak, a robber a thief, and this kind of robber slips in and out of buildings unnoticed

explanation.walkthrough: Sneak means an informer, and the thief who steals is joined to it; the parenthesis hints at taking things from in between.
explanation.definitionFit: A sneak thief is a burglar who steals from open premises without breaking in.

clue.text: Outcome of refusal to indicate yes of no

definitions.text: Outcome of refusal to indicate yes of no

parts.words: Outcome of refusal to indicate yes of no
parts.note: declining to vote either for or against a motion produces this result

explanation.walkthrough: 'yes of no' is the newspaper text for 'yes or no'.
explanation.definitionFit: An abstention is a formal declining to vote either way.

clue.text: Name passed on from father to son

definitions.text: passed on from father to son

explanation.definitionFit: Gene is a man's first name, as in Gene Kelly; a gene is a unit of heredity handed down from parent to child.

clue.text: Sort of industry that depends on good field-work

definitions.text: Sort of industry that depends on good field-work

parts.words: Sort of industry that depends on good field-work
parts.note: field-work suggests research outdoors, but here it is literal labour on farmland

explanation.definitionFit: Farming is the industry of tilling fields and raising crops.

clue.text: Charm School manual?

parts.note: a charm can be a magic spell, so a textbook for a school of charms would teach spells, punning on a book that teaches how words are written

explanation.definitionFit: A primer teaching how words are written out letter by letter in school.

clue.text: Biology's self-change mechanism

parts.note: in evolution, organisms alter over generations to suit their environment

explanation.definitionFit: Biological adaptation is the process by which a species becomes better fitted to its surroundings.

clue.text: Twitch under a reproach for having a bad image

indicators.note: in a down clue the twitch sits under, so after, the other pieces

parts.note: a stigma is a mark of disgrace or reproach
a tic is a nervous twitch

explanation.surface: Someone twitches under criticism for their poor public image.
explanation.walkthrough: 'bad image' looks like reputation, but means blurred eyesight.
explanation.definitionFit: Astigmatism is an eye defect that distorts vision, so the focus is faulty.

clue.text: To speak contemptuously is normal among the aged set

indicators.note: among means placed in the middle of the other letters
set means arranged or settled, so these letters are rearranged

parts.note: par is the normal or standard level

explanation.surface: Badmouthing the elderly is common among some groups.
explanation.walkthrough: 'the aged set' looks like a group of elderly people; 'set' is the anagram signal and 'the' is only a link.
explanation.definitionFit: To disparage is to belittle or speak slightingly of someone.

clue.text: Such old people can least run wild

indicators.note: wild suggests disorder and abandon, so these letters are scrambled

parts.note: R is the cricket scorer's abbreviation for a run

explanation.surface: The elderly may be the least able to go wild.
explanation.walkthrough: 'run wild' reads as one phrase, but 'run' gives R to the fodder and 'wild' alone is the anagram signal.
explanation.definitionFit: Ancestral describes forebears, people of earlier generations in a family.

clue.text: Girl before the start of her race

parts.note: Iris is a girl's name

indicators.note: the start of means only the first letter is taken

explanation.surface: A young woman lining up just before her running event begins.
explanation.walkthrough: 'race' seems an athletic event; it means a people or nation.
explanation.definitionFit: The people of Ireland are spoken of as a nation or ethnic group.

clue.text: Left with the right to dress up

indicators.note: with here means holding, so the right letter goes inside the other word

parts.note: pink is slang for mildly left-wing in politics
R is the standard abbreviation for right

explanation.surface: A politician of the Left gaining the right to dress smartly.
explanation.definitionFit: To prink is to smarten oneself up fussily, to preen.

clue.text: Joined together to recite ago, for example

explanation.definitionFit: Conjugate means coupled or paired; to conjugate a verb such as Latin ago is to recite its forms.

clue.text: Drunken diarist meant to carry on affairs

indicators.note: drunken suggests staggering about, so the letters are reeled into a new order

explanation.surface: An inebriated diary-writer who was supposed to be running the business.
explanation.definitionFit: To administrate is to manage or run the business of an organisation.

clue.text: Replace umpire over the matter

indicators.note: in a down clue over means placed above, so first

parts.note: ref is short for referee, an umpire
it can stand for the matter under discussion

explanation.surface: Swapping the umpire because of the issue at hand.
explanation.definitionFit: To refit is to re-equip or fit out again, putting in new parts.

clue.text: Resentment of Nevada, say

indicators.note: say tells us to speak the letters out loud and spell the sound

parts.note: NV is the postal abbreviation for the US state of Nevada

explanation.surface: Jealousy felt towards the state of Nevada.
explanation.definitionFit: Envy is a jealous grudge at another's good fortune.

clue.text: Observer who is a sucker for striped material

definitions.text: who is a sucker for striped material

explanation.definitionFit: A seer is one who sees; followed by sucker it forms seersucker, a puckered striped cotton.

clue.text: Some Nato intelligence about a Greek character

indicators.note: about means turned round, so the run is read backwards
some means only part of the words is taken

explanation.surface: A scrap of NATO intelligence concerning a Greek individual.
explanation.walkthrough: 'character' looks like a person; it is a letter of the alphabet.
explanation.definitionFit: Iota is the ninth letter of the Greek alphabet.

clue.text: No ordinary kind of security

parts.note: in finance, shares are split into ordinary and a priority class that gets dividends first

explanation.definitionFit: Preference shares rank ahead of ordinary shares for dividends.

clue.text: City in charge in Tyneside, perhaps

indicators.note: in means placed inside, so the abbreviation goes within the region

parts.note: Tyneside is in the North East of England, abbreviated NE
IC is the usual military and business short form for the person responsible

explanation.surface: The city authority runs things in the north of England.
explanation.definitionFit: Nice is a city on the French Riviera.

clue.text: Linesman who sets the table?

parts.note: a railway worker who lays track sounds like a waiter laying out dishes

explanation.definitionFit: A platelayer is a railway worker who lays and maintains track.
